verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as batch filings or bulk record updates, are a fair question for a government business-filing service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any bulk or batch capability. The Gateway items mention only single-profile updates, Filing Administrator enhancements and login tips, and the probes show ohiosos.gov and the filing portal returning 403 on robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
